page_one.title:
Claude advisory
and engineering
for your business.
page_one.intro: We help you decide where Claude can be useful, connect it to your existing systems and check whether it is doing the job. You work directly with the specialists responsible for delivery.
page_one.band_body: Engagements run for at least 12 months, with ongoing advisory and engineering support. We review the work together before agreeing to renew.

offers.title: Decide what is worth building
offers.body: We look at how your team works today, what takes too much time and what it costs. Together, we choose a starting point with a clear business case.

offers.title: Build it around your existing systems
offers.body: We connect the tools and data the work depends on, test with representative cases and agree where a person needs to review or approve a result.

offers.title: Keep track of how it performs
offers.body: After launch, we review quality, cost and the problems your team encounters. We plan improvements within the support and engineering scope you have agreed.

page_one.closing: You work with the people who design and build your solution.

page_two.title:
What we agree
before work begins.
page_two.accelerator_body: The engagement includes PromptForce.AI from DayTwoAI.com to support readiness assessment and development with reusable components. Adapt Cloud handles the advice, integration and engineering for your business.
page_two.accelerator_note: Your agreement sets out the platform access, included usage and support.

steps.label: 01  SCOPE
steps.body: We agree on the work, the systems involved, who needs to participate and how we will judge the result.

steps.label: 02  DELIVERY
steps.body: Your statement of work sets the milestones and tests you will use to accept each stage of delivery.

steps.label: 03  REVIEWS
steps.body: Monthly reports and quarterly meetings give us time to discuss what is working, address problems and decide what comes next.

page_two.proof_title: How you know the work is done
page_two.proof_body: The statement of work says what we will deliver, how it will be checked and what happens if we miss a commitment. Depending on the project, we might measure handling time, corrections or cost per completed task. We agree on the targets and quality requirements with you before delivery.
page_two.renewal: Before renewal, we review the results and agree on the work and support you need for the next term.
page_two.cta: Tell us what is slowing your team down.
page_two.cta_body: Email info@adaptcloud.io with the process you want to improve. We will discuss whether it is a good fit and where to begin.
